Canonical elementary metrics and source positivity pass, but the complete physical quotient/pencil is not assembled.
Tree mediator elimination passes; one-loop matching does not exist.
The V50 selector policy is reusable, but the enlarged candidate field/action census has not been rerun and cannot inherit the V50 pass automatically.
Factor spaces and PS primitives are explicit; the same-action physical Wilson array is missing.

V51_exact_results.statement: The 465-component source chart has an exact rank-22 broken orbit and an exact Hermitian rank-443 quotient projector.
One normalized superpotential gives an exact F/D-flat tuned witness.  Its 465x465 symmetric Hessian obeys HQ=0, has rank 443, and is nondegenerate on the physical source section.
The PS parity, all 48 degree-two/three source rows and all 34 PS superpotential/derivative primitives are explicit with direct chirality tensors and ordered-orientation rules.
Exact D5 character intersections decide every remaining degree-four row and a finite normalized Cartesian factor registry resolves every nonzero copy channel.

V51_exact_results.statement: A 5-site 4D N=1 moose has an exact 567x612 Clifford-lock Jacobian of rank 567, leaving precisely the 45 Spin(10) orbit tangents; projected rectangular transport has exactly 32 desired chiral profiles.
The source U(1) normalization and nonzero vector/Goldstone spectra match, but the exact PS/SU5 incidence partition leaves 12 uneaten A5-like chirals.

With canonical dynamical multipliers and g=0.73, the optimistic one-loop Spin(10) Landau poles occur below 1.70 link scales, rejecting this polynomial moose as a controlled perturbative UV completion.

candidate_architecture.definition: A finite 4D N=1 product-Spin(10) moose whose vector and spinor links are locked by covariant Clifford constraints, with a PS endpoint projector, the exact 210+126+bar126+singlet source action, rectangular chiral transport and vectorlike channel mediators.
candidate_architecture.name: Clifford-locked PS-to-Spin(10) deconstructed source-mediator candidate
rescue_hypotheses_not_constructed: a lean link realization with far smaller total Dynkin index
a genuine strong/composite link sector reproducing the same local orbit

frozen_G2_contract.closure_logic: G2_closed iff C1 through C7 all pass for the same retained action
frozen_G2_contract.definition: A fixed-order tree-level Wilsonian source/portal boundary EFT in one declared regulator scheme, with a complete retained-order local action, an action-derived positive self-adjoint domain, and a component-resolved full-tower kernel for that same action.

not_required_for_G2.G6: compute the complete pole tower, thresholds, unification and RG flow

not_required_for_G2.G8: perform the flavor/neutrino fit and withheld prediction
not_required_for_G2.UV: predict the infinite irrelevant tower from a fundamental UV completion

gate_ledger.blocker: No V50/V51 same-action identity; 12 residual A5-like chirals; full physical metric/pencil, one-loop rematch and Wilson array missing; candidate perturbative UV control fails.

gate_ledger.advance: An explicit tuned Cartesian F- and D-flat witness has exact Hessian rank 443 on the physical source quotient.
gate_ledger.blocker: m1=M1=0 lacks radiative protection; the 12 endpoint chirals, full scalar potential, soft terms and global vacuum selection remain open.

gate_ledger.advance: The missing PS mu_H term is now identified as an allowed input rather than silently forbidden.
gate_ledger.blocker: The mu/Bmu mechanism, SUSY breaking, radion stabilization, EWSB and complete scalar vacuum are absent.

gate_ledger.advance: No excluded dark benchmark is reintroduced.
gate_ledger.blocker: No dark-sector Lagrangian, relic calculation or cosmological history is specified.

gate_ledger.advance: The candidate spectrum is explicit enough for a one-loop Spin(10) perturbativity kill test.
gate_ledger.blocker: At g=0.73 the optimistic Landau poles are only 1.6975 and 1.6610 link scales above threshold; no lean or strong/composite UV completion is built.

gate_ledger.advance: All 168 source-row multiplicities/factor channels and 34 PS primitive projector tensors are resolved.
gate_ledger.blocker: No final contracted physical Wilson array, dressing/running or B/L rates.

gate_ledger.advance: The PS census now includes complementary Hc Higgs cubics and the allowed family/bulk Kähler mixings.
gate_ledger.blocker: There is no complete component Clebsch map, neutrino completion, family fit, uncertainty propagation or withheld prediction.

same_action_decision.reason: V51 changes the microscopic U(1) topology and adds link, multiplier, transport and mediator fields.  Exact subblocks therefore cannot be combined with V50 clause passes as one action until an explicit matching identity exists.

scientific_verdict.statement: V51 is a concrete and falsifiable representation-faithful route.  It solves the source-orbit/Hessian and invariant-factor subproblems, but its first polynomial moose realization fails perturbative UV control and contains 12 unlifted endpoint chirals.  It is not a completed or validated theory.
